sourceSummary: Preston North End 2026/27 post-window roster cross-check using FootballSquads and current transfer records, with latest published Transfermarkt market values. Snapshot ages are recalculated to 11 September 2026 where valuation pages predate summer birthdays. Stanley Mills and Liam Gibbs are treated as current Preston players using post-window transfer evidence even where older valuation profiles still show their former/parent clubs.

Daniel Iversen.notes: DOB 19 July 1997 gives age 29 at the snapshot. Goalkeeper maps to SWOS code 0; latest published valuation €2.5m.

Lee Nicholls.notes: Goalkeeper maps to SWOS code 0; latest published valuation €0.4m.

Pol Valentin.notes: ASCII football name matches Pol Valentín. Primary right-back role maps to SWOS RB code 1; latest published valuation €0.6m.

Andrija Vukcevic.notes: ASCII football name matches Andrija Vukčević. Primary left-back role maps to SWOS LB code 2; latest published valuation €0.5m.

Harry Clarke.notes: Current transfer records show Clarke joined Preston in August 2026; the latest published Transfermarkt valuation €2.5m predates that move. Primary right-back role maps to SWOS RB code 1.

Liam Lindsay.notes: Centre-back maps to SWOS defender code 3; latest published valuation €1.0m.

Jordan Storey.notes: DOB 2 September 1997 gives age 29 at the snapshot. Centre-back maps to SWOS defender code 3; latest published valuation €4.5m.

Alfie Devine.notes: DOB 1 August 2004 gives age 22 at the snapshot. Tottenham confirms the July 2026 permanent transfer. Attacking/central midfield maps to SWOS midfield code 6; latest published valuation €8m.

Ali McCann.notes: Central midfield maps to SWOS code 6; latest published valuation €2.2m.

Thierry Small.notes: DOB 1 August 2004 gives age 22 at the snapshot. Although staged broadly as a midfielder, his primary current role is left-back, mapped to SWOS LB code 2. Latest published valuation €7m.

Jordan Thompson.notes: Central midfield maps to SWOS code 6; latest published valuation €0.7m.

Liam Gibbs.notes: Post-window transfer records show the 1 September 2026 Preston loan from Norwich; older valuation profile still shows Norwich ownership. Central midfield maps to SWOS code 6; latest published valuation €1.5m.

Andy Moran.notes: Identity uses Andy Moran while Transfermarkt renders Andrew Moran. Attacking/central midfield maps to SWOS code 6; latest published valuation €1.5m.

Jusef Erabi.notes: Current Preston loan from Genk. Centre-forward maps to SWOS attack code 7; latest published valuation €2m.

Callum Lang.notes: DOB 8 September 1998 gives age 28 at the snapshot. Primary right-wing role maps to SWOS RW/RM code 4; latest published valuation €2.5m.

Stanley Mills.notes: Post-window transfer records show Mills joining Preston on 27 August 2026; an earlier August report had anticipated a January move before circumstances changed. Latest published valuation €1m comes from his Oxford registration. Primary right-wing role maps to SWOS RW/RM code 4.
